verdict.rationale: Jan is a local LLM chat app, so chatting offline with your own documents through retrieval-augmented generation is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents document upload, indexing, embeddings or automatic retrieval. The only file-related mentions describe autonomous agents that 'read files', which is an adjacent agent capability, not RAG over a user's documents.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation
